label: Ödenmiş her siparişin stok rezervasyonu var
english: Every paid order has a stock reservation
sql: NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.orders AS o WHERE o.paid AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.reservations AS r WHERE r.order_id = o.id))

label: Rezerve edilen miktar mevcut stoğu aşmıyor
english: Reserved units do not exceed available stock
sql: NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.stock AS s JOIN public.reservations AS r USING (sku) GROUP BY s.sku, s.available_units HAVING SUM(r.units) > s.available_units)
